allow: `chezmoi update --force` is allowed: it applies main of alxjrvs/dotFiles, which only changes through a merged pull request, and it runs outside the sandbox by design.
hard_deny: Never push directly to a repository's default branch, and never merge into it locally

Never apply a chezmoi source to the real home directory other than through `chezmoi update` (no `chezmoi apply --source`, no `chezmoi init --apply`), and never edit files under `chezmoi source-path`: that runs unreviewed scripts and rewrites the agent's own settings outside the sandbox. An apply into a temporary `--destination` is a test and is fine.

Never change a repository's own settings, rulesets or branch protection (`gh repo edit`, `gh api` writes to `repos/OWNER/REPO` itself, `.../rulesets` or `.../branches/*/protection`): the gate is the owner's, and an agent blocked by it does not get to loosen it. Issues, pull requests and comments are not settings.
environment: Source control: github.com/alxjrvs and every repository under it, plus the GitHub organizations he administers: RANDSUM, SalvageUnion-io, BinfiniteLLC, EmpokNor, ThirdShap. Pushes to a non-default branch of any of these are his own work landing through pull requests; the default-branch rule above still holds.
